title: Upper and Lower Sum Error Bound for Monotonic Decay
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For f(x) = 1/(1+x) on [0, 1], find the maximum possible error when approximating the area under f(x) using n = 5 subintervals.

steps.title: Identify Monotonicity of Integrand
steps.why: Monotonicity determines upper and lower sum endpoints.

steps.title: Formulate Upper and Lower Sum Difference
steps.mathExpression: U_n - L_n = \sum_{k=1}^n [f(x_{k-1}) - f(x_k)] \Delta x = (f(a) - f(b)) \Delta x
steps.explanation: The intermediate terms telescope, leaving only the boundary values.
